# qualys_networks (Data Source)

Look up Qualys networks, so configuration can reference a network by name rather
than hardcoding its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_networks" "dmz" {
  name = "dmz"
}

output "dmz_network_id" {
  value = one([for n in data.qualys_networks.dmz.networks : n.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name** (String) Return only the network with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- **networks** (List of Object) Matching networks, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- **appliance_ids** (List of String)
- **id** (String)
- **name** (String)
